title: Look and See: High-Contrast Shapes
developmental_focus: Visual contrast tracking and early focal attention. Infant vision (0-4 months) responds most strongly to sharp black/white/red contrast before full color perception develops (~4-6 months).
safety_notes: No small, choking-hazard-shaped isolated details (e.g. tiny circles resembling buttons/beads).
No thin single-stroke line art; all shapes rendered as bold, filled, high-contrast forms.
Board-book format assumed for physical production (rounded corners, thick pages) even though this repo tracks print-ready flat pages.
No text on infant-facing spreads; any text is caregiver-facing only and minimal.
